title: What's New in v2.9.66
notes: 📁 Roster File Import & Fast Sync: Added file upload support (.csv, .json, .txt, .tsv) to the 'Add Player to Roster' modal for instant bulk roster synchronization.
📊 Smart File Parsing & Table Preview: Automatically detects headers and presents parsed players in a clean scrollable preview table with duplicate filtering.
⚡ Direct Sync & Bulk Table Populator: Choose between 1-click Direct Sync with live progress bar or loading into the multi-row bulk editor to review before saving.
📥 Starter Templates: Added 1-click downloads for sample CSV and JSON roster templates.

latestChanges: v2.9.66: Added Roster File Import & Fast Sync (.csv, .json, .txt, .tsv) to Add Player modal with live preview and sample templates
v2.9.65: Upgraded Bug/Feedback resolution note editor to a spacious multi-line textarea with quick templates and pre-wrap formatting
v2.9.64: Enabled debounced background cloud auto-save and streamlined the Save button with live sync status indicators
v2.9.63: Added real-time auto-calculation and locked summary inputs in Alliance Championship Admin Suite
